channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Trump’s Iran deal, Israel’s meltdown
item.description: The precarious memorandum of understanding between the US and Iran.

item.title: Family, including two daughters, killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
item.description: Israel has repeatedly violated the October ceasefire brokered by the US.

item.title: US envoy headed for Switzerland, Israeli strikes on Lebanon threaten talks
item.description: US media are reporting that Witkoff and Kushner are preparing for negotiations with Iran after talks were postponed.

item.title: Iran war day 113: Tehran presses US over Lebanon ceasefire
item.description: Iran presses US over Lebanon as Israeli strikes test fragile ceasefire and broader peace efforts.

item.title: Iran war live: Tehran says US must ensure Israel ends attacks on Lebanon
item.description: Iranian deputy foreign minister says Iran 'ready to move forward' on diplomacy with US, but war must end on all fronts.

item.title: Israel and Hezbollah agree ceasefire, US says, as more Lebanon strikes reported
item.description: The agreement followed concerns that continued clashes would undermine the deal to end the war between the US and Iran.

item.title: Italy's Meloni says Trump 'made up' story that she 'begged' him for photo at G7
item.description: The highly public exchange is an indication that their earlier close ties have frayed since Trump's decision to go to war with Iran.

item.title: In Trump's shadow, Vance becomes face of Iran deal
item.description: His fierce defence of the Iran plan amid mounting criticism comes as speculation intensifies about a possible 2028 presidential run.

item.title: Thirty-five killed as gunmen attack Niger's biggest airport
item.description: Niger has been fighting a militant Islamist insurgency for a decade and in January suspected jihadists attacked the same airport.

item.title: Bowen: US-Iran deal raises inescapable question of what the war was for
item.description: While the human cost is clear, the Iranian regime has not just survived the war, it has been empowered.
